description: Four rows, each holding a two-into-one switch and a one-into-two switch, with a master control that flips every one of them at once

params.text: While held, it flips all eight switches; with the Latch button on, each press flips them and they stay flipped
Changes the master control from following its gate to toggling on each press, so one press flips all eight switches and leaves them flipped
Chooses which of the two inputs of its row is passed to the C output, and sets the one-into-two switch of that row as well while that switch's own jack is empty
Changes both switches of its row from following their gates to toggling on each rise, so one press flips them and they stay flipped

inputs.text: Above 0.5V it flips all eight switches, and it replaces the master button once a cable is in it
Above 0.5V it chooses the second of the two inputs of its row, replacing that row's Switch button
Above 0.5V it sends that row's one-into-two switch to its second output, replacing whatever the two-into-one switch of the row is set to
The first input of the two-into-one switch of its row, passed to the C output while the switch is off
The second input of the two-into-one switch of its row, passed to the C output while the switch is on
The input of the one-into-two switch of its row; with no cable it takes the C output of the two-into-one switch on the same row

outputs.text: Carries whichever of that row's two inputs the switch has chosen, and 0V if neither has a cable
Carries that row's one-into-two input while its switch is off, and 0V while the switch is on
Carries that row's one-into-two input while its switch is on, and 0V while the switch is off

notes: each row is two separate switches, a two-into-one and a one-into-two; they share a button but can be given different gates
the master control inverts every switch rather than setting it, so it swaps whatever each row was doing
nothing is faded or crossfaded: a switch jumps from one signal to the other, and the unused output of a one-into-two switch is held at 0V
every jack is monophonic, whatever is patched in
this module carries no right-click menu of its own, so it has no panel-colour choice; its panel is always the dark one
